positions.subject: q:education/sfusd-proximity-assignment
positions.summary: Tung supports a zone-based assignment system that gives families a school within a reasonable distance of home, with the option to seek programs not offered in their neighborhood.

citations.quote: Families deserve predictability and a high-quality school within a reasonable distance of home.
He says the lottery creates anxiety and drives families away, so he supports a zone-based system.
citations.locator: Positions on Key Issues, student-assignment question

citations.quote: I want to reform the SFUSD Student Assignment Policy (Board Policy 5101.2).
